== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Lirin is a young individual who possesses an intimate knowledge of The Grave{{!}}the Grave, navigating its gray corridors with ease. He is the child of two parents who possess extraordinary auditory abilities, allowing them to hear sounds from any location. Lirin views his parents as highly protective figures who prioritize his safety, though he sometimes finds their unconventional methods of training and recreation to be unusual. During a recent encounter in his home environment, Lirin interacted with a desk containing a shallow bowl; upon placing his hand inside, he experienced a tingling sensation in his fingertips.}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|While his father was lost in thought, Lirin was instructed to place his hand into a bowl and cycle his [[madra]]. Despite being worried that the process might cause him pain, he followed the directions while his parents watched with concern for his safety. Upon placing his hand in the bowl, Lirin felt a distinct reaction from his cores as two forms of power resonated with the energy within. This interaction ultimately produced a blue-white cloud and a sculpture shaped like a frozen tree.}}
